content:
Priya: Hey team — need quick deal-desk approval. Liam is requesting a one-off pricing amendment for Orbital Analytics' 6-month pilot. Ask: 15% off list for pilot term, and temporary reduction in partner commission from 5% -> 2% for months 1-3. Reason: competitive displacement, strategic integration, low ARR but high strategic value. Need finance + legal sign-off so sales can finalize SOW.

Liam: FYI, competitor quoted 20% off and faster integration credits. Customer wants a short pilot to validate. If we don't move on price/partner comp we lose the PoC. Proposed guardrails: discount limited to pilot SKU, no renewal carryover, cap total credits at $12k.

Priya: Quick impact calc: ```
List ARR (annualized equivalent if converted): $25,000
6mo revenue @ list: $12,500
6mo revenue @ 15% discount: $10,625 (delta = -$1,875)
Partner commission @ 5% on discounted: $531
Partner commission @ 2% on discounted (months1-3): ~$213 -> ~-$318 savings to Redwood over pilot term
Net one-time hit (rev + commission delta): ~ -$2,193
```This is a small short-term hit vs strategic upside.

Jules: I support in principle. Two asks before I greenlight: 1) add $12k total credit cap in the SOW, 2) explicit clause that renewal pricing reverts to standard list unless a new agreement is signed. Also require Sales to record the win reason in CRM.

Marta: Legal can draft amendment language. We should label it a "one-time promotional concession" and include a 30-day notice to terminate the pilot. Also include a non-transfer clause for partner co-sell rights. I can turn around redlines today if Sales drops the SOW.

FinanceBot: Policy check: one-off discounts >=10% require Revenue Manager approval and finance ops review. Please include the deal desk form and estimated revenue impact. See internal policy: https://intranet.redwood/finance/discounts (internal).

Priya: Thanks. @Liam @Marta can you upload the SOW + partner email thread and confirm the $12k cap in the doc by EOD? If we get Legal redlines and Sales attestation I'll route to Revenue Ops for final sign-off.

Liam: Will upload SOW and partner chain by 2475011200, will add CRM note. If everyone is good, I'll mark as "deal-desk pending" and set renewal guardrails. :thumbsup:

Priya: Great — tagging Revenue Ops once uploaded. Circle back after redlines.
